nodes.label: Program anchor
nodes.description: Stable ProgramPK, governance, Type, StartYear, security, publication, deletion, and skip state. It intentionally has no ProgramId.

nodes.label: Program state
nodes.description: Versioned ProgramId, name, status, cost, creator, timestamp, and import reference.

nodes.label: Program stage history
nodes.description: Associates a Program state with a lifecycle Stage.

nodes.label: Program Type
nodes.description: Program classification referenced physically through Id.

nodes.label: Program Stage dictionary
nodes.description: Stage labels and StageHierarchy business ordering.

nodes.label: Program Type/Stage matrix
nodes.description: Zero-or-one JSON-backed active-stage matrix row per Program Type.

nodes.label: Project anchor
nodes.description: Stable ProjectPK equal to the initial ProjectId, plus Program ownership, type, groups/wallet, publication/readiness flags, and lock metadata.

nodes.label: Lifecycle/base Project revision
nodes.description: Ordinary scalar Project state used by current-stage editing and lifecycle advancement.

nodes.label: Project stage history
nodes.description: Associates a Project revision with a Program lifecycle Stage.

nodes.label: Project funding
nodes.description: Funding rows owned by a base Project revision.

nodes.label: Project component
nodes.description: Component Total and classification owned by a base Project revision.

nodes.label: Component cost per year
nodes.description: Annual amount and schedule owned by a component SQL Id.

nodes.label: Major work item
nodes.description: Year-specific major work owned by a component SQL Id.

nodes.label: Major work location
nodes.description: Location owned by a work-item SQL Id; YearOfWork is inherited from the work item.

nodes.label: Program stage advancement
nodes.description: Advances exactly one configured Stage, creates a new Program state, copies every active Project and its complete child graph, then preserves the source as read-only history.

nodes.label: Immediate next Stage only
nodes.description: Initial creation may use any allowed Stage; later advancement must use the next allowed Stage only. Jumps, reversals, and same-Stage copies are rejected.

nodes.label: All active Projects advance
nodes.technical: tProjects.ProgramFK and active lifecycle source selection
nodes.description: Every active Project advances automatically. Incomplete or invalid Projects do not block the Program and are not left behind.

nodes.label: Stage-specific ProgramId
nodes.description: Each destination Program revision receives a new unique ProgramId and starts as Working status 3. tPrograms has no ProgramId.

nodes.label: Stable ProjectPK, changing ProjectId
nodes.description: ProjectPK is the initial ProjectId and never changes. Advancement recalculates only the ProjectId Stage prefix: BP, MY, or P.

nodes.label: Read-only Stage history
nodes.technical: Program/Project revision and Stage write guards
nodes.description: Successful advancement adds destination rows; prior Program, Project, Stage, and child rows become read-only historical data.

nodes.label: Project publishability
nodes.description: Derived independently for each GAA-R Project. Failed Projects remain in GAA-R for correction and do not block Program advancement.

nodes.label: Published baseline
nodes.description: Publishes eligible Projects to PCMA after GAA-R. Only publishable Projects are selected; invalid Projects remain unpublished.

nodes.label: Revision Type
nodes.description: Required first selection. RevisionGroupId scopes optional Categories and Reasons.

nodes.label: Optional Revision Category
nodes.description: Required only when the selected Revision Type has active Category rows for the same RevisionGroupId; otherwise Category remains null.

nodes.label: Revision Reason
nodes.description: Always filtered by Revision Type and additionally by Category when the Type has Categories.

nodes.label: Reason Category encoding
nodes.description: No Category FK or seed data proves how one/multiple Categories and the no-Category case are encoded. Inspect deployed rows and current parser before implementing filtering.

nodes.label: Formal Revision transaction
nodes.description: Post-publication workflow root attached to stable ProjectPK and an originating base ProjectRevisionFK.

nodes.label: Formal Revision snapshot
nodes.description: Proposed scalar Project data isolated until complete approval.

nodes.label: Revision approval
nodes.description: One row per formal Revision Detail and approval level.

nodes.label: Revision workflow documents
nodes.description: Stores formal Revision documents. IsApprovedDocument = 1 means the separate CO approval document; confirm whether zero exclusively means the IO submission document.

nodes.label: IO Submit document modal
nodes.description: Before every IO Submit/Resubmit action, the modal requires a valid IO document. Document evidence and review-queue transition belong to the same command attempt.

nodes.label: CO Approve document modal
nodes.description: Before CO approval/publication, the modal requires a separate CO document classified by IsApprovedDocument = 1.

nodes.label: IO queue
nodes.description: Draft, RO-correction, and returned-from-CO ownership. The IO document is collected in the Submit/Resubmit modal, not after RO approval.

nodes.label: RO queue
nodes.description: Submitted formal Revisions awaiting RO review.

nodes.label: CO queue
nodes.description: RO-approved formal Revisions awaiting CO review. RO approval routes directly here because IO documentation was required at submission.

nodes.label: Fully approved formal Revision
nodes.description: RO status 4 and CO status 4.

nodes.label: Effective Project
nodes.description: Latest fully approved formal Revision when available, otherwise latest active base Project revision.

nodes.label: LS/wallet cost ambiguity
nodes.description: Current database objects do not share one canonical LS/wallet Program-cost definition.

nodes.label: Stage/revision mismatch
nodes.description: Independently selecting the latest revision and highest Stage can combine incompatible rows.
